recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow current-build source clarification that completes the published issue without changing cardinality or broader terminology behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-14688 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether ValueSet.expansion.contains.version should be 0..* because the existing wording, "Version in which this code/display is defined", was unclear about whether the version was the first code-system version, any version, or multiple versions. The approved resolution changed the definition to describe the version of the code system from which the code was taken and did not approve a cardinality change.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 40be6cb27713195324b576ca019afbea271aed52 / SVN revision 14638 by changing source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml to the approved detailed definition text. That application left the old short wording unchanged, and the current StructureDefinition source still had that short text while already carrying max=1 and the approved detailed definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet in the active [resources] section and maps valueset to the vocab work group, so source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml is current-build core source. Earlier related issues FHIR-3535 and FHIR-13810 established the optional expansion.contains.version element and conditional server guidance for code-system versions; neither supports changing the element to 0..*. Confluence Vocab minutes for 2018-07-12 corroborate the Persuasive with Mod disposition and 15-0-1 block vote. Zulip searches found tracker and commit announcements but no conflicting substantive discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml so ValueSet.expansion.contains.version.short says "Code system version used for this code". The approved 0..1 cardinality, detailed definition, and comment were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml: changed ValueSet.expansion.contains.version.short from the ambiguous original wording to "Code system version used for this code".

related_jiras.note: Introduced ValueSet.expansion.contains.version as an optional element for code systems where version matters.
Clarified conditional server guidance for reporting expansion code-system versions and supports leaving the element optional.
Later triaged extension-pack idea about expansion warnings; not final and not needed for this core source clarification.
